security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data: asset: http://asset.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: GUI for systemd timers and user cron
bundle.longDescription: Cronaut is a modern desktop frontend for managing systemd --user timers and the current user's crontab on Debian-based Linux. It runs in the system tray, supports light/dark/system theming, and never makes network calls.
